issues.claim: J-A120.01's index row (base l. 22398) says Find's base parts are built at M5 "its base parts widening the O12 line by 0.5–1 pw", and its Part A entry (rationale l. 836) "widen the O12 line by an itemised 0.5–1 pw (PLAUSIBLE) under §16's rule". §16 prices them by absorption — the O12 line's "item 112's second cues and checked variants and item 120's Find roles and marks absorbed (its overlay provider and panel are volume 9's, AP11)", the components paragraph's "the base parts of items 120, 123 and 125 are absorbed — item 120's key, roles, listing and exports by the O11 and O12 lines" — and J-A568.05 reads "items 121, 122 and 124 widening the O12 line by 2.25–3.75 pw, items 120, 123 and 125 absorbed"; O12's 10.75–16.75 = 8.5–13 + 2.25–3.75 holds no 0.5–1 for item 120. One price, two statements.
issues.required_change: J-A120.01's index row ends "— built at M5 with volume 1's area and gap services, its base parts priced by absorption into the O11 and O12 lines (its overlay provider and panel volume 9's AP11; J-A568.05)". Its Part A entry's last clause reads "its base parts (§2.9's key, §8.2's marks, §9.5's tool, §11.1's export, §11.2's listing, §12.5's budget) are priced by absorption into the O11 and O12 lines whose mechanisms they extend, its overlay provider and panel being volume 9's AP11 (J-A568.05) (§13.2, §13.8, §16)." §16 and its totals unchanged.

issues.claim: Item 125 (e) (owner): "the same dossier with and without a host context yields the identical document and hash"; R2-40 (2) keeps `line` as one of the fields "none able to change a document a dossier makes"; §14's `HostContext` ("none changes a document a dossier makes (T125-2)") and T125-2 ("with and without a host context, and under each `HostContext` field (`audience`, `displayNames`, `line`), yields the identical document and hash"). V08 §2.4's *Selection* (l. 685–694) tries `HostContext.line` first and states "only where two registered lines accept one dossier … does `line` decide which line's reading builds it"; B19 (l. 2023) and T-V8-11 ("Two registered adapters both accepting: `HostContext.line` picks when given; with none, … a new settlement is created on the newest line") give a different document with and without a host context in that case, and T-V8-61 (b) tests T125-2 only with `line` the pinned line. V08 recorded this as its judgment 2 for the adjudicator and scope's repair left it as a hand-off; a volume's rule contradicting the owner's bar (precedence: owner > base > volume).
issues.required_change: V08 §2.4's *Selection*: the dossier's own shape and stamps select the adapter in every case — (1) the document's bound line when its adapter accepts, (2) the single registered adapter that accepts, (3) at a creation with several accepting, the newest registered line, recorded and noted `line_defaulted` — and `HostContext.line` is checked, never chosen from: a named line no adapter supports, or one the dossier's stamps contradict, refuses with `E_LINE_UNSUPPORTED`; a named line that is registered and accepts but differs from the selection leaves the selection standing, the report naming both lines. The sentence "only where two registered lines accept one dossier … does `line` decide which line's reading builds it" reads "with several registered lines accepting one dossier the dossier's own selection still decides, so one dossier makes the same document and hash with and without a host context (item 125 (e); T125-2)". B19's case reads "two registered adapters accept a new settlement's dossier, a line named or not" (outcome unchanged). T-V8-11's two-adapter clause reads "Two registered adapters both accepting: the same document and hash with `HostContext.line` naming either line and with none — a bound document on its line, a new settlement on the newest, noted `line_defaulted`"; T-V8-61 (b) adds that two-adapter fixture. A J-V8 row records the choice; §14 and T125-2 unchanged (R2-40 (2)'s "it picks the adapter" then reads as the check above — the adjudicator to confirm).

V09 §4.12 words the same fallback as a default ("`AppPrefs.touch.editFabric` defaults to false for coarse pointers, hiding the L3 FABRIC and L4 FINISH layers' geometry edits"), switchable, and T-V9-22 runs T126-1 without naming the setting: the meeting of item 126's bar and the touch fallback is undefined.
issues.required_change: §13.4's fallback clause reads "… and the fabric and finish layers' geometry edits are off by default on a coarse pointer (`AppPrefs.touch.editFabric`, V09 §4.12), switchable back on and never removed (item 126 (e)), stated in the guide"; §1.1's sentence reads "Tablets keep every tool, under touch and pen (V09 §4.12); §13.4's touch fallback changes only a default"; T126-1 reads "… completes its canvas script under touch, with `AppPrefs.touch.editFabric` on". V09 writes T-V9-22's end in the same words (R2-05).
